Strategy

Operation Mount Doom - Quest Plan

Ending the danger for good instead of hiding it for another age.

TL;DR

The Council will carry the Ring on foot, by back roads, to the fire where it was made and unmake it there - a small company can slip through where an army would be seen.

Fictional example

An affectionate homage used as a demo. Not affiliated with any rights holder; every number is made up.

Why now

  • The Enemy is searching for the Ring and its riders are already abroad.
  • Hiding it again only delays the danger, and using it corrupts whoever holds it.
  • A small company can slip through where an army would be seen.

The shift

The plan ends the danger for good instead of hiding it for another age.

Goals

  1. Stay unseen

    Reach Mount Doom without being seen.

  2. Keep moving

    Keep the Ring-bearer fed, sheltered, and moving.

  3. Unmake it

    Unmake the Ring in the fire where it was made.

Numbers we care about

9

Walkers in the company

+12%

Pace since Rivendell

Leagues per day

4.6

Rating of the inn at Bree

Phases

  1. Autumn - The Council

    The Council meets at Rivendell.

  2. Winter - The mountains

    Cross the mountains and pass through Moria.

  3. Spring - The last march

    March to the mountain.

Old vs new plan

Strength first

March an army → fight at the gate → be seen long before arriving.

Stealth first

Send a small company → take the back road → reach the fire unseen.

Risks

  • Exposure Being seen by the Enemy on open ground.
  • Supply Supplies running short after the mines.
  • Corruption The Ring's pull on whoever carries it.
